kebab_example: aliyun ga list-custom-routing-endpoints --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --accelerator-id ga-bp1odcab8tmno0hdq0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListCustomRoutingEndpoints

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance. Only cn-hangzhou is supported
parameters.help_zh: 全球加速实例所在的地域ID，仅取值cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in a paging query. Maximum value: 50. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的条目数。最大值：50。默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) whose endpoints you want to query
parameters.help_zh: 待查询终端节点列表的全球加速实例ID
parameters.name: accelerator_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the listener whose endpoints you want to query
parameters.help_zh: 待查询终端节点列表的监听ID
parameters.name: listener_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the endpoint group whose endpoints you want to query
parameters.help_zh: 待查询终端节点列表的终端节点组ID
parameters.name: endpoint_group_id

AcceleratorId.description_en: The instance ID of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) to which the endpoint belongs
AcceleratorId.description_zh: 终端节点所属全球加速实例ID

Endpoint.description_en: The name of the vSwitch instance for the endpoint
Endpoint.description_zh: 终端节点交换机（vSwitch）实例名称

EndpointGroupId.description_en: The ID of the endpoint group to which the endpoint belongs
EndpointGroupId.description_zh: 终端节点所属终端节点组ID

ListenerId.description_en: The ID of the listener to which the endpoint belongs

ServiceId.description_en:
The ID of the service provider to which the managed instance belongs.

This parameter is valid only when the ServiceManaged parameter is set to true
ServiceId.description_zh:
托管实例所属的服务方ID。

仅在ServiceManaged参数为True时有效

ServiceManaged.description_en:
Specifies whether the instance is a managed instance. Valid values:

true: The instance is a managed instance.

false: The instance is not a managed instance
ServiceManaged.description_zh:
是否为托管实例。取值：

true：是托管实例。

false：不是托管实例

ServiceManagedInfos.description_en:
The list of action policies that users can execute on the managed instance.

This parameter is valid only when the ServiceManaged parameter is set to true.
When an instance is in the managed state, user operations on the instance are restricted, and certain operations are prohibited
ServiceManagedInfos.description_zh:
用户在此托管实例下可执行的动作策略列表。

仅在ServiceManaged参数为True时有效。
当实例处于托管状态时，用户对实例的操作会受到限制，某些操作行为会被禁止

items.description_en: The list of action policies that users can execute on the managed instance
items.description_zh: 用户可在该托管实例执行的动作策略列表

Action.description_en:
The name of the managed policy action. Valid values:
Create: Create an instance.
Update: Update the current instance.
Delete: Delete the current instance.
Associate: Reference or be referenced by the current instance.
UserUnmanaged: Unmanage the instance.
CreateChild: Create a child resource under the current instance
Action.description_zh:
托管策略动作名称，取值：
Create：创建实例。
Update：更新当前实例。
Delete：删除当前实例。
Associate：引用/被引用当前实例。
UserUnmanaged：用户解托管实例。
CreateChild：在当前实例下创建子资源

ChildType.description_en:
The child resource type. Valid values:

Listener: Listener resource.

IpSet: Acceleration region resource.

EndpointGroup: Endpoint group resource.

ForwardingRule: Forwarding rule resource.

Endpoint: Endpoint resource.

EndpointGroupDestination: Endpoint group protocol mapping resource under a custom routing listener.

EndpointPolicy: Endpoint traffic policy resource under a custom routing listener.

This parameter is valid only when the Action parameter is set to CreateChild
ChildType.description_zh:
子资源类型，取值：

Listener：监听资源。

IpSet：加速地域资源。

EndpointGroup：终端节点组资源。

ForwardingRule：转发策略资源。

Endpoint：终端节点资源。

EndpointGroupDestination：自定义路由监听下的终端节点组协议映射资源。

EndpointPolicy：自定义路由监听下的终端节点通行策略资源。

仅在Action参数为CreateChild时有效

IsManaged.description_en:
Specifies whether the managed policy action is managed. Valid values:
true: The managed policy action is managed. Users do not have the permissions to perform the operation specified by Action on the managed instance.
false: The managed policy action is not managed. Users can perform the operation specified by Action on the managed instance
IsManaged.description_zh:
托管策略动作是否被托管，取值：
true：托管策略动作被托管，用户无权在托管实例下执行Action指定的操作。
false：托管策略动作未被托管，用户可在托管实例下执行Action指定的操作

TrafficToEndpointPolicy.description_en:
The traffic policy for the backend service. Valid values:

AllowAll: Allow all traffic to access the specified backend service.

DenyAll: Deny all traffic from accessing the specified backend service.

AllowCustom: Specify the destinations that can receive traffic
TrafficToEndpointPolicy.description_zh:
后端服务流量通行策略。

AllowAll：允许所有访问流量访问指定后端服务。

DenyAll：拒绝所有访问流量访问指定后端服务。

AllowCustom：指定可以接收访问流量的通行目标

Type.description_en:
The backend service type of the endpoint. Valid values:

PrivateSubNet: Private CIDR block
Type.description_zh:
终端节点后端服务类型。

 PrivateSubNet：私网CIDR

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page in a paging query
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时每页的条目数
